name: supplier-disruption-assist
description: Manufacturing Wave 1 Cowork plugin: get ahead of a supply problem. Picks up a late PO, shipment delay, shortage or supplier notice, maps the shortage through BOM/where-used to the affected products, production lines, open orders and at-risk dates/quantities (deterministic shortage_impact_map), recommends a mitigation (expedite / substitute / reschedule) and computes an escalation tier (deterministic mitigation_recommend), then drafts the supplier follow-up and the internal escalation brief. Draft-first; nothing is auto-sent and no PO/ERP record is written. Starts from PO and email data; graduates to live monitoring when portal and ERP alerts are connected. Grounded in ERP/MRP (D365 SCM, SAP), PO & shipment data, supplier master and BOM/where-used.
